name: Everpure

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Everpure logo.png, 764 px wide)

description: Everpure (formerly Pure Storage) sells all-flash data storage and a data-management platform (FlashArray, FlashBlade, Portworx, Evergreen architecture) to organizations, as hardware sold up front and as subscriptions (Evergreen//One storage-as-a-service and related Evergreen subscription offerings). Revenue was $3.66 billion in FY2026 (+16%); subscription annual recurring revenue was $1.92 billion (+16%). It reports one segment, has never paid a dividend, and runs a $1.8 billion buyback. GAAP operating margin is only 3.1% because of heavy sales and R&D spending.

employees.note: About 3,700 in the U.S. and over 2,700 internationally at the end of fiscal 2026.

businessLines.name: Product (hardware and software licences)
businessLines.how: One-time sales of FlashArray and FlashBlade systems (with the Purity operating software) lumpy with large deployments and refresh cycles.

businessLines.name: Subscription services
businessLines.how: Customers pay recurring fees for Evergreen//One (storage as a service sold on defined service-level outcomes, independent of hardware) and support subscriptions, recognised over the term; cost of subscription revenue $433.4M (74.4% gross margin).
